title: ₹13,600 crore Metro takeover loan stuck; Railway Minister 'not aware'

slides.head: ₹13,600 crore Metro takeover loan stuck; Railway Minister 'not aware'
What happened
slides.body: IRFC signed an agreement in May but has not released about ₹13,600 crore, state officials say.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The state needs the loan to complete the Phase I takeover from L&T; the Centre wants that done before Phase II.

slides.head: Loan not yet disbursed
slides.body: L&T already pushed the Phase I handover deadline from May 1 to December.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Phase II plans 122 km of new corridors at ₹38,595 crore.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether the cabinet approves switching to another lender before the December handover deadline. Ask: Who runs Metro day to day once the state takes over?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
₹13,600 crore Metro takeover loan stuck; Railway Minister 'not aware'

Railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said Metro Phase II isn't under his purview and he isn't aware of the IRFC loan Telangana needs to take over Phase I from L&T.

Why it matters: The state needs the loan to complete the Phase I takeover from L&T; the Centre wants that done before Phase II.

Source: Times of India. Image: Times of India
